name: LG4X

args.name: rateDist
args.description: A discrete distribution with exactly four categories, supplying component rates and probabilities

description: A mixture of four empirical amino-acid substitution models fitted to sites with different evolutionary rates. The rate distribution supplies a rate and a mixture probability for each of the four matrices, in matrix order. Unlike LG4M, the rates are not constrained to follow a gamma distribution.

citation.title: Modeling Protein Evolution with Several Amino Acid Replacement Matrices Depending on Site Rates
